content: Supabase Supavisor session pooler connection string: postgres://postgres.<project-ref>:<password>@<cloud>-0-<region>.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres. Username MUST be postgres.<project-ref> (dot-separated), not bare postgres — this is the exact detail the prior tinysaas project got wrong. Port 5432 = session mode (IPv4-safe, one physical connection per client, supports prepared statements). Port 6543 = transaction mode (deprecated for session-mode use since Feb 28 2025; now transaction-mode only).
